faq.q: What is the '67 Vapid Dominator Buggy in GTA 6?
faq.a: It is a 1967 model-year Vapid off-road buggy included as an Ultimate Edition benefit. Rockstar's official site pairs it with a garage and lists four official screenshots of the vehicle.

faq.q: How do you unlock the '67 Vapid Dominator Buggy?
faq.a: It comes with the Grand Theft Auto VI Ultimate Edition, alongside a garage. Rockstar has not described any separate purchase or unlock method outside that edition.

faq.q: What related content comes with the Dominator Buggy?
faq.a: The Ultimate Edition pairs the buggy with a garage, according to Rockstar's official edition material. Rockstar has not listed any further bundled items specific to this vehicle.

faq.q: Is the '67 Vapid Dominator Buggy based on a real vehicle?
faq.a: Rockstar's official sources do not identify a real-world basis for the buggy. Community comparisons exist, but they are not treated as official identification here.

faq.q: What performance can the Dominator Buggy achieve?
faq.a: Rockstar has not published final performance statistics, price or a full technical specification. Only its manufacturer, model year, off-road classification and edition inclusion are confirmed.
